hero_subhead: For 25 or more seats with needs a standard plan can't cover — bespoke event venue access, streamlined onboarding, and Den 1880 as vendor of record.
enterprise_eyebrow: Custom contracts · 25+ seats · Bespoke venue access
enterprise_intro: For 25+ seat contracts with bespoke needs (event venue access, onboarding, vendor of record for HR procurement, etc.). Scaled pooled credits and plans, quarterly business reviews, and custom commercial terms. Per-seat rates, inclusions and exclusions are fully custom at this scale, talk to our sales team for details.
usecases_heading: Two reasons companies sign team contracts
usecases_intro: Either you have remote workers in KW who need somewhere to sync, or you're a local team that wants the wellness and amenities without paying for your own office. Both get the gym.
usecase1_heading: Want your KW remote workers back together in person?
usecase1_body: If you have a distributed workforce with employees in Waterloo Region, they need a real place to work, train, and sync in person. Shareable Day Pass Bundles let any of your local team walk in and use the space. Full Team plans give them daily access plus The Performance Club and wellness amenities, the kind of health benefit that bigger companies pay a vendor for. One corporate contract, transferable seats, single invoice.
usecase1_who: For: HR, People Ops, and Workforce leads at large corporations
usecase2_heading: Want to run your business here without owning an office?
usecase2_who: For: Founders, COOs, Ops leads of small teams
